stories.title: Zipline hits $21.5B valuation as Walmart expands bet on drone delivery
stories.take: Zipline raised $1.5 billion at a $21.5 billion valuation as Walmart expands its bet on drone delivery.

stories.title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
stories.take: Dropbox is buying Tigris Data for $350 million to build DBX Agent Cloud, a storage platform for developers building AI models and agents.

stories.title: Instagram brings Edits to desktop to take on CapCut
stories.take: Instagram brought its Edits video editor to desktop, putting it in more direct competition with ByteDance's CapCut.

stories.title: Agility Robotics' Nasdaq debut invites scrutiny of humanoid robot market
stories.take: Agility Robotics, the US leader in deploying humanoid robots, went public on the Nasdaq today — the first pure humanoid robot company on the stock market, and a test of whether the market believes the hype.

stories.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
stories.take: Axiom Math is betting on verification as AI floods math with unchecked proofs — its agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field's biggest libraries.

stories.title: Bluesky hit peak usage for the year on election night
stories.take: Bluesky hit peak usage for the year on election night, with posts and likes doubling during the midterms.

stories.title: TikTok quietly launches a stand-alone TikTok Shop app
stories.take: TikTok quietly launched a standalone TikTok Shop app with personalized recommendations, livestream shopping, and in-app checkout.

stories.title: Publicis Groupe Fires Back at WPP Over Cindy Rose’s ‘CEO Handshake’ Comments
stories.take: Publicis published an open letter firing back at WPP chief Cindy Rose, calling her 'CEO handshake' claim an insult to clients' intelligence — holding-company rivalry, now in public.

stories.title: In graphic detail: Six thousand brands later, ChatGPT ads still have a conversion problem
stories.take: Six thousand brands later, ChatGPT ads still have a conversion problem: OpenAI's ad growth is outrunning the proof that it works, and hitting its revenue targets depends on advertiser demand and measurement.

stories.title: Why Liquid Death’s media chief is determined to break away from LiveRamp
stories.take: Liquid Death's media chief is determined to break away from LiveRamp after Publicis acquired the identity-graph company — and other marketers are auditioning alternatives too.

stories.title: Waymo Bets Women’s Safety Can Help Win Over Robotaxi Skeptics
stories.take: Waymo's second-ever national campaign bets women's safety can win over robotaxi skeptics — and it was developed by an all-female creative team.

stories.title: How Fresh Step used AI to go from brief to ads at one-tenth the cost
stories.take: Fresh Step used AI to go from brief to finished ads at one-tenth the usual cost — the clearest case yet of AI compressing the creative production pipeline.

stories.title: Daft Punk, Doctor Doom, and E.T. Unite in Lego’s Action-Packed Holiday Ad
stories.take: Lego's holiday ad unites Daft Punk, Doctor Doom, and E.T. racing through a festive brick workshop to 'One More Time.'

stories.title: Wemby draws MVP chants with career performance, predicts more to come
stories.take: Victor Wembanyama put up career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds with eight blocks to power the Spurs past the Mavericks, then said it should be like this more often — he's finally getting his legs back after starting the season sick.

stories.title: Redick lauds Luka as latest hot streak continues
stories.take: Luka Doncic dropped another 40 points on the Kings, joining Kobe Bryant and Elgin Baylor as the only Lakers ever to score 35-plus in six straight games.

stories.title: Super 8: Thompson's game-winning 3 completes Heat's dramatic comeback
stories.take: Klay Thompson's corner 3 — his eighth of the game — with one second left in overtime completed Miami's dramatic 117-116 comeback over the Clippers.

stories.title: Should the NBA shorten games to 40 minutes? Pros and cons of move as league battles early season injury crisis
stories.take: With an early-season injury crisis mounting, the league is weighing shortening games to 40 minutes — Commissioner Adam Silver supports the idea, but it would have to be carefully measured.

stories.title: Even Nikola Jokic might not be able to save these Nuggets
stories.take: Denver's roster was never built to overcome any slippage from its three-time MVP — and even Nikola Jokic might not be able to save these Nuggets.

stories.title: Biggest MLB offseason questions: How long will lockout last? Will we see a free agency frenzy?
stories.take: The biggest offseason question hangs over everything: how long will the likely lockout last, and will there be a free agency frenzy before it hits?

stories.title: Your guide to MLB free agency: Rankings and contract projections for the top 50 free agents
stories.take: Free agency is open: rankings and contract projections for the top 50 free agents, and how much the biggest stars are likely to get paid this winter.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Yankees eyeing reunion with top reliever, plus Phillies, Marlins identify areas of need
stories.take: Today's hot stove: the Yankees are eyeing a reunion with a top reliever, while the Phillies and Marlins have identified their areas of need.

stories.title: Guardians' Clase exploited by 'serial liar,' his attorneys say at trial
stories.take: At his federal pitch-rigging trial, Guardians closer Emmanuel Clase's attorneys argued he was exploited by a 'serial liar' — taken advantage of, not a cheater.

stories.title: Kanzler rides atypical path to Mariners job: 'He left us no choice'
stories.take: Seattle introduced Jason Kanzler as manager — an analytics and data-friendly hire who, in the club's words, 'left us no choice' after Dan Wilson's firing.

stories.title: US elections 2026 live: Republicans blast their party’s midterms collapse, blaming Iran war and affordability crisis
stories.take: The Republican blame game is in full swing after the midterms collapse, with party figures pointing at the Iran war and the affordability crisis — while Mississippi's Senate race stays on a knife's edge.

stories.title: Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats must end Iran war, hold Trump accountable. But how?
stories.take: Sen. Gillibrand says the new Democratic Congress must end the Iran war and hold Trump accountable — the open question is how, with a veto pen waiting at the White House.

stories.title: The election brought a wave of historic firsts. Here are some groundbreaking winners
stories.take: Tuesday's election brought a wave of historic firsts, from Deb Haaland becoming the first Native American woman elected governor in New Mexico to a string of other groundbreaking winners.

stories.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
stories.take: Russell Brand was convicted of rape and sexual assault, and the judge told him he will get a prison term.

stories.title: Six people dead and seven injured after fire at Brooklyn home
stories.take: Six people are dead and seven injured after a fire at a Brooklyn home.

stories.title: Multiple planes diverted as bomb threats to commercial flights reported across Europe – live
stories.take: Multiple planes were diverted as bomb threats to commercial flights were reported across Europe — a developing story through the day.

stories.title: How did California’s gerrymander work out? Better than Texas’
stories.take: California's gerrymander worked out better than Texas': Democrats won at least 240 House seats and flipped the Senate, picking up more than two dozen seats — raising the question of whether Prop. 50 was even needed.

stories.title: California’s election featured a big showdown over taxes. Wealth tax defeat was the biggest
stories.take: The wealth tax's defeat was the biggest result in California's ballot showdown over taxes — Propositions 40 and 42 keep up the state's long trend of rejecting tax hikes at the ballot box.

stories.title: California has one ballot-counting trouble spot. It’s the one run by an election denier
stories.take: California's one ballot-counting trouble spot is Shasta County — the one run by Clint Curtis, a Trump election denier.

stories.title: New deadline for phaseout of gas water heaters gives Bay Area homeowners one more year
stories.take: Bay Area homeowners get one more year before the gas water heater phaseout bites, and up to half of households can skip electric models under the updated air-district rule.

stories.title: L.A. businesswoman fabricated workers, salaries in COVID fraud, netted millions, prosecutors say
stories.take: An L.A. businesswoman was indicted for allegedly fabricating workers and salaries in an $18 million COVID relief fraud scheme.

stories.title: Palisades arson case: Second trial begins against man accused of sparking wildfire
stories.take: A second trial began against the man accused of sparking the Palisades fire, one of the most destructive wildfires in L.A. history.

stories.title: The hidden supply chain costs of the AI boom
stories.take: Economist Willy Shih's thesis: supply chains follow economics, not politics — tariffs don't reshore production, they reroute it and raise prices in the end • The AI boom's real pressure point is memory chips: AI demand has far outstripped capacity, and Shih predicts its 'true political end' comes when GTA 6 launches and a PS5 costs more than at launch because of memory prices • His alternative to autarky: trade within a bloc of like-minded partners with a long-term strategy, instead of tariff policy that whipsaws every few weeks

stories.title: DF Direct Q+A: Current-Gen Consoles: Success Or Failure?
stories.take: The answer is a split verdict — technically a success, industrially bittersweet: John calls it genuinely good, Oliver is quite positive on the tech, Rich is bittersweet because the business shifted from making great games to extracting revenue • Sony's own data says 75% of players choose 60fps performance modes, and the panel is pessimistic that Chinese RAM makers can relieve GPU prices against near-inexhaustible AI demand

stories.title: Trump blames Iran war for midterm defeat
stories.take: Trump said his decision to go to war with Iran was partly responsible for the Republican defeat — but told reporters he would do it again • JD Vance broke ranks further: 'The reason we lost is the war,' fueling talk he's distancing himself ahead of 2028 • Also: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong got 10 more years in prison, and Senate races in Alaska and Mississippi (margin under 100 votes) are still counting

stories.title: James Bosworth on What Comes After Lula's Stunning Win
stories.take: Bosworth's answer for Lula's stunning win: 'Flávio was a terrible candidate and Lula was a great candidate' — winning round one was the worst thing for Flávio because the runoff became a referendum on Bolsonaro, not Lula • Prediction markets had Bolsonaro at 80%, peaking at 87%, and simply missed; Lula's WhatsApp group passed 10 million members and drove voters to the polls • On Venezuela: no election this year — it needs a six-to-nine-month runway, with the Rubio plan targeting roughly July

stories.title: Exclusive: The Onion Wants a Bowl Game. (Seriously.) Let's Make It Happen, America.
stories.take: The Onion is seriously trying to buy the title sponsorship of a real Division I bowl game on ESPN — FBS sponsorships start around $400,000, and it has been rejected twice so far: officials heard 'Sickos Bowl' as 'sex pervert bowl,' and the New Orleans Bowl's foundation said a flat no on politics • The print paper is the engine: 86,000 subscribers makes it the country's fourth-largest newspaper, 14,000 short of passing the Washington Post • ESPN legend Kenny Mayne signed on as the bid's respectable face, and the inaugural Puerto Rico Bowl still has no sponsor

stories.title: Democrats Sweep Congress — And Stocks Explode Higher
stories.take: Stocks exploded on the sweep: the Dow jumped 3% (its best day since April 2025), Brent crude fell 8% to $95, and big tech added nearly $1 trillion in value while neo-cloud stocks tanked • Catherine Rampell reads it as a rebuke of Trump on affordability — gas up 40% year over year, mortgages above 7% — more than a Democratic mandate • Data centers were a top issue: voters approved 30-plus local restrictions versus one easing, and 56% called AI and data centers a crucial or major factor

stories.title: The Voters Who Flipped Congress
stories.take: Nate Cohn's breakdown: Democrats sit at 54 Senate seats with a path to 56, and 237 House seats with 250-plus possible — their largest majority in a generation • The flip came from turnout: Black and Hispanic shares of the electorate surged while young men swung from Trump +10 in 2024 to over 60% Democratic, and young white Republicans stayed home • Roughly $10 billion in spending barely mattered — Republicans outspent Democrats by $200 million in Texas and lost by double digits

stories.title: Can Anthropic make enough money to justify its value?
stories.take: The answer is 'only if': revenue exploded from $41 million in all of 2023 to over $33 billion in the last nine months, but Anthropic has committed to spend about $900 billion on computing — roughly half in the next four years • The valuation is earned only if sales keep growing fast enough to pay those bills and the AGI bet pays off — reaching recursively self-improving AI first would force every business to plug in or be left behind • The circular economy in one line: Anthropic owes Amazon $110 billion over 10 years while Amazon is simultaneously its supplier, customer, investor, and competitor

stories.title: Raman extends lead over Bass, Inglewood Mayor runoff, Rep Garcia targets Trump's family— Morning Edition
stories.take: Raman extended her lead over Mayor Bass to more than 26,000 votes (3+ points) with about 72% counted, and Decision Desk HQ has called the mayor's race for her • Inglewood's mayoral race is heading to a March 2 runoff, with Council member Gloria Gray at 32% ahead of the incumbent's 29% • Long Beach Rep. Robert Garcia is set to chair House Oversight and says he'll investigate Trump's family first — plus the Lakers beat the Kings 116-103 behind Luka Doncic's 40 points in his 100th game for LA

stories.title: Catching Up With More Fall Games
stories.take: Echo Weaver is the consensus pick — a 2D time-loop Metroidvania pitched as 'Outer Wilds, but 2D,' where you start with all your abilities and knowledge, not gear, unlocks the map; mechanically ingenious, though all three hosts ding the writing • Escape Academy 2 was loved by all three as a co-op couples game — discrete escape rooms plus an open-world campus of smaller puzzles, with an optional timer • Sleeper hit: Star Wars Galactic Racer, a character-driven roguelike racer with a wonderfully hateable rival

stories.title: Democrats' First 100 Hours, Outstanding Midterm Races, Trump Doubles Down On Policies
stories.take: The Democrats' promised first-100-hours agenda: restore the enhanced ACA subsidies, reverse last year's Medicaid cuts, reassert Congress's authority over tariffs, and try to force an end to the Iran war • If Alaska and Mississippi break their way, the Senate majority reaches 54 seats plus two independents — the biggest since the ACA era; the AP poll has men shifting 12 points and Latino voters 21 points toward Democrats • Trump doubled down, saying of the Iran war: 'Probably it's true' that it hurt Republicans, 'but if I had it to do again, I'd have to do it again'

stories.title: The Cost of Living Crisis Isn’t Going Away
stories.take: The cost-of-living crisis isn't going away: central banks in Australia, Brazil, and Sweden warned high prices are here to stay, markets expect more rate hikes, and the inflation peak likely hasn't been seen yet • The Senate margin is still unknown at 54, 55, or 56 — Alaska is under 1,000 votes with ranked-choice counting not starting before November 18, Mississippi is about 1,100 votes • Data-center backlash is biting: Meta's president says she spends about 80% of her time securing compute, and Ohio's and Texas's governors-elect have both called for conditional construction freezes
